$comment: Per-instance configuration for orangesmiley.is (the public company site). Resolved by server/config/clientConfig.js; CLIENT_CONFIG_* env vars override anything here. NO SECRETS — this file is committed and logged in full at boot. selfUpdate stays 'managed' until the release channel of SELF-UPDATE-PLAN Phase 5 exists; Orange Smiley's own instances move to the 'canary' channel then, so we soak our own releases before customers see 'stable'. The `identity` block (D-021, 2026-09-22) is what makes this product THIS product — brand, visitor locale, theme trio, hero clip, the public nav (surface.nav: ordered { route, labelKey } entries after Home — the top nav, both footers and the sitemap derive from it), hidden surfaces, Organization record. This repo is the engine, so its values equal the schema defaults and are spelled out here as the worked example a downstream copies and edits (docs/ENGINE-SYNC.md §6); tests/unit/identityConfig.test.js pins them.

routes.$comment: A product's OWN public routes' meta, merged over the engine's ROUTE_META/DEFAULT_META and pageTitle table (identity-seam-3): { "/console": { "titleKey": "meta.console.title", "descriptionKey": "meta.console.description", "titleMode": "bare"|"suffix", "noindex": true|false, "locale": "is"|null, "contentKeys": ["verdskra"] } }. The keys resolve through the i18n overlay (product.<locale>.json); noindex = <meta robots noindex> + a robots.txt Disallow + never in the sitemap; locale = locale-locked like the party pages (301 under any other prefix, one canonical, listed under its own locale only); contentKeys = the site_content rows the page renders, the sitemap's <lastmod> source for that route. Empty in the engine.

organization.description: Icelandic software company building and operating websites, online stores and business systems for small and medium businesses — one platform, one monthly subscription.

mfa.$comment: Halli 2026-09-23: 'change mfa to optional'. 'optional' = nobody is forced to enrol two-factor sign-in; the Prófíll panel offers it and an account that has enrolled is challenged at every sign-in. 'required' = an unenrolled admin / accounts holder has admin / the accounts view withheld until it enrols (server/auth/mfaPolicy.js). Published sellers need 2FA for the seller area either way (routes/sellerRoutes.js rule 4). Env override: CLIENT_CONFIG_SECURITY_MFA_ENROLMENT. docs/ADMIN-2FA.md.

write.$comment: The MCP catalogue write tools (create_product, update_product, set_stock — harvest-ice-c-2026-09-24). Each is OFF until set true here or by CLIENT_CONFIG_MCP_WRITE_<NAME>; they also need MCP_ALLOWED_SCOPES to include write and the shop module on. orangesmiley.is keeps them all off (Halli 2026-09-24).

modules.$comment: Which modules this instance HAS (R4, 2026-09-24; catalogue: server/config/moduleCatalog.js). preset = all | vefur | verslun | rekstur — a Rekstrarkerfið tier, or every module. A switch set here ("shop": { "enabled": false }) or by CLIENT_CONFIG_MODULES_<ID>_ENABLED beats the preset. OFF = absent: the module's APIs and uploads 404 before auth, its pages 404 with noindex, its admin views leave the sidebar and the role editor; no data is touched. orangesmiley.is keeps `all` — its shop, news, party and bio are HIDDEN (identity.surface.hiddenRoutes: still working at their URLs, Halli's rule), not switched off.
